title: pi-lsp-onread configuration
description: Extension-owned configuration for pi-lsp-onread. Global file: ~/.pi/agent/lsp.json. Project file: .pi/lsp.json. Layered files may contain partial server overrides; required fields are validated on the merged effective configuration at runtime. $schema itself is an editor hint; the extension still validates at load time.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema, e.g. "./lsp.schema.json" for a copy next to the config file.

lsp.description: Map of server id to server definition, or false to disable every LSP server. No servers are enabled by default; activation happens on the first matching read/edit/write.

command.description: Server argv; executed without a shell. Required once the merged configuration enables the server.

extensions.description: File extensions (leading dot) or whole filenames without an extension (e.g. "Dockerfile").

languageId.description: LSP languageId, or a per-extension map for multi-language servers; the map must cover every configured extension.

rootMarkers.description: File or directory names used to find the nearest project root; falls back to the configured project root.

disabled.description: Disable this server. Tombstone entries need no other fields.

env.description: Literal environment variable overrides layered over the inherited process environment.

initialization.description: Server-specific options sent with the LSP initialize request (free-form).

settings.description: Server configuration returned for workspace/configuration requests and didChangeConfiguration (free-form).

retryCooldownMs.description: Delay before retrying a failed server start (default 60000).

maxConsecutiveStartFailures.description: Consecutive failed starts before disabling the server for this session (default 3).

onRead.description: Reads never wait; 'cached' appends available diagnostics with freshness labels, 'off' disables injection (activation is unaffected).

onChange.description: Behavior after successful edit/write tool results.

waitMs.description: Total feedback wait budget after edits/writes, including cold server startup.

maxItems.description: Global output cap across all matching servers for the current file.

maxChars.description: Global character cap for injected diagnostic text.

serverDiagnostics.description: Per-server policy override. Output caps (maxItems/maxChars) stay global and cannot be overridden per server.
